description: Scaleway's OpenAPI export drops query parameters that belong to a proto `oneOf`, so `ListOS` lose filters the API takes. The official JS SDK sends them through `resolveOneOf` in `urlParams` — scaleway-sdk-js packages_generated/dedibox/src/v1/api.gen.ts — with the types in the sibling types.gen.ts. They are added as optional query members; the API enforces the one-of. Live on 2026-10-12: `ListOS` with neither answered `invalid_arguments` ("You must set an offer_id or a server_id."); with an Offer's `offer_id` it answered the OS list, with the Offer's `id` it answered "The selected choice is invalid".

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Filter OS by compatible server ID. One-of `filter`: exactly one of `server_id`, `offer_id` — the API rejects a call with neither.

Filter OS by compatible offer: the Offer's `offer_id` (the product, e.g. Pro-8-XS), not its `id` (one priced variant), which the API rejects as an invalid choice. One-of `filter`: exactly one of `server_id`, `offer_id` — the API rejects a call with neither.
